texto: The **Se fossi in te + condizionale** formula is irreplaceable to advise without sound tax: **Se fossi in te, parlerei con il responsabile** (if I were you, I would talk to the responsible); **Se fossi in te, chiederei chiarimenti** (if I was you, I would ask for clarification).
It's much more elegant than the direct imperative.
Please note: **Se hai fame, c'è della pizza nel frigo** (if you are hungry, there is pizza in the refrigerator); **Se hai bisogno di aiuto, dimmelo subito** (if you need help, tell me right away).

filas: Se fossi in te, aspetterei domani.
If I were you, I'd wait for tomorrow.
Se fossi in te, chiederei un aumento.
If I were you, I'd ask for a raise.
If you're thirsty, have some water.
Se serve una mano, chiamami pure.
If you need a hand, call me without hesitation.

frases.it: Non so se accettare questa nuova offerta di lavoro a Torino.
frases.es: No sé si aceptar esta nueva oferta de trabajo en Turín.
frases.en: I don't know whether to accept this new job offer in Turin.
analisis: I don't know if to accept

frases.it: Se fossi in te, parlerei prima con il responsabile delle risorse umane.
frases.es: Si yo fuera tú, hablaría primero con el responsable de recursos humanos.
frases.en: If I were you, I'd talk to the human resources officer first.

frases.it: Hai ragione. E se mi offrissero lo stesso stipendio?
frases.es: Tienes razón. ¿Y si me ofrecieran el mismo sueldo?
frases.en: You're right. What if they offered me the same salary?

frases.it: Se ti offrissero le stesse condizioni, chiederei un rimborso per le spese di trasporto.
frases.es: Si te ofrecieran las mismas condiciones, pediría un reembolso para los gastos de transporte.
frases.en: If you were offered the same conditions, I would ask for a refund for transport costs.

bloques.pregunta: What formula does Claudia use to advise Marco respectfully?

opciones.explicacion: It puts its own approach at the place of the interlocutor by means of an imfect and conditional congiuntive.
The imperative mandate would be too aggressive or too intrusive.
It recommends dialogue with the company, not to shut up.

bloques.frase: Se tu fossi in me, che cosa ___ in questa situazione difficile?

opciones.explicacion: Second person singular («tu faresti») present condition.
It is present of indicative: actual fact consummated.
It is congiuntive and imfect and cannot act as a consequence.

bloques.pregunta: What advice does this statement give?
bloques.frase: Se fossi in te, aspetterei domani prima di prendere una decisione.

opciones.texto: It recommends caution and postpone the decision until the next day.
opciones.explicacion: «Aspetterei domani» does not advise to rush at the present time.

opciones.texto: It demands that you sign the employment contract immediately without reading it.
opciones.explicacion: It's a good thing you think about it.

opciones.texto: He noted that the decision had already been adopted unanimously yesterday.
opciones.explicacion: It is a present dilemma that requires reflection.

bloques.frase: Se fossi in te chiederei subito un consiglio al professore
bloques.traduccion: If I were you, I'd be right to ask the teacher for advice.
bloques.explicacion: Empathic advice formula with «se fossi in te» and conditional.

bloques.pregunta: What does the «Se hai fame, c'è del pane sul tavolo» phrase mean?

opciones.texto: Establece un ofrecimiento práctico y real para resolver una necesidad presente.
opciones.explicacion: Type I applied to daily domestic courtesy.

opciones.texto: He suggests that going hungry is beneficial to health.
opciones.explicacion: It offers immediate and hospitable food.

opciones.texto: Remember, the bread was finished last night.
opciones.explicacion: He claims there's bread available on the table.

bloques.frase: Se ti ___ un contratto a tempo indeterminato, accetteresti subito?

opciones.explicacion: Third person of plural of the «offrire» imfetus congiuntive.
The conditional is wrong after the «se» particle.

bloques.pregunta: What is the tone of this offer?
bloques.frase: Se serve un aiuto con i bagagli, chiamami pure a qualsiasi ora.

opciones.texto: Maximum cordial availability and generosity towards the traveller.
opciones.explicacion: «Chiamami pure» is the Italian formula par excellence to provide uncompromised help.

opciones.texto: I absolutely refuse to cooperate with the transfer of bags.
Legal obligation imposed by the transport regulation.
opciones.explicacion: It's a friendly gesture of personal courtesy.

intro: The «se» conjunction is not only for abstract hypotheses: in real life it is the preferred instrument for offering diplomatic advice and resolving daily contingencies.
